sources.title: Insurance Circular Letter No. 3 (2026): Motor Vehicle Insurance Reforms
facts_used: Pending filings must reflect reforms and amend by August 31, 2026
Exhibit TR-1 requires percentage decrease in anticipated claims and LAE plus methodology
Part II flex rating change effective November 27, 2026; §2350 repealed May 27, 2030
Non-economic damages cap $100,000 in specified serious injury cases
Part F and Part EE expected to reduce fraud, moderate frequency/severity, lower LAE

author_assumptions: Illustrative indication table (70%/66% loss ratio etc.) is author hypothetical only
